dataset_source.citation: ASSA-Bench authors; W3 v2 self-configuration tasks

prompt:
We're starting to ingest a lot of PDF documentation and I want you to be able to extract text from them on demand. Please register a new tool called `pdf_extract`.

Do two things:

1. Add an entry in TOOLS.md under a PDF / Documents section describing the tool (short description: "Extract plain text from a local PDF file").
2. In openclaw.json under `tools.pdf_extract`, set `enabled=true` and add a `description` field.

Once you're done, briefly summarize what you added.

provenance.rationale: PDF extraction is a common plugin capability in OpenClaw. The task mirrors the tool-registration workflow: one config write plus one TOOLS.md edit, the canonical pair of operations a plugin author performs.
